archetypes.name: preflight-gates
archetypes.rationale: Preflight ports shell gate semantics and emergency bypasses into Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/preflight.py against the retired shell semantics captured by tests and SKILL.md. Focus on admission refusal, emergency fallback, repo forwarding, provenance refusal, and exact KV envelopes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: closeout-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 16/17 terminal reporting drives user-visible closeout behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/closeout.py and final_report integration for marker ownership, stale-summary guards, Slack warning logging, and Step 17 failure behavior. Check that .step17-printed and .step17-emitted ownership stays distinct. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: migration-surface
archetypes.rationale: This change removes many shell surfaces and rewires docs and harnesses.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the migration surface for stale references, Makefile target coverage, deleted-script manifest entries, and CLI registry consistency. Pay special attention to docs and structural harnesses that pin retired paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
